Category & Vision

Define market categories and strategic direction that positions SAP as a leader in emerging and established markets.

Know Learn Do
Know

What is Category & Vision?

Understand what you own, what great looks like, and how to measure it.

⚠️ Needs PMM Validation
Role Card

What this area is

Category & Vision is the practice of defining the market landscape SAP plays in and the strategic direction that guides product positioning. It answers where we compete, how we frame the opportunity, and what future we're building toward — setting the context for all downstream messaging and go-to-market activity.

Responsibilities

  • Define and evolve market category definitions
  • Create category vision narratives
  • Identify whitespace and adjacency opportunities
  • Align product roadmap to market evolution
  • Build thought leadership around category POV

Key deliverables

  • Category definition document
  • Market vision presentation
  • Competitive landscape map
  • Category narrative brief
  • Analyst category storyline
Playbook
1

Market landscape analysis

Map the current category definitions, key players, and emerging trends. Identify how analysts and buyers frame the space.

2

Vision development

Define SAP's point of view on where the category is headed. Articulate the future state and SAP's role in it.

3

Stakeholder alignment

Validate the category vision with product, strategy, and field leadership. Ensure alignment before external activation.

4

External activation

Brief analysts, develop thought leadership content, and embed the vision into sales narratives.

5

Measure & evolve

Track category perception through analyst rankings, share of voice, and deal win rates. Refresh annually.

Success Metrics
Analyst Ranking
Position in key analyst category evaluations
Category Share of Voice
SAP mentions vs. competitors in category coverage
Vision Pull-Through
% of sales decks using category narrative
Whitespace Pipeline
Revenue from newly defined category segments
